from typing import overload

class Cart:
    items: list[int]
    def __init__(self, capacity: int) -> None: ...
    @overload
    def add(self, item: int) -> None: ...
    @overload
    def add(self, item: str) -> None: ...
    @property
    def total(self) -> int: ...

def open_cart(cart_id: str) -> Cart: ...

VERSION: str
